title: Move over, credit cards: Social-media stars are tapping magic wands to buy things
summary: Tap-to-pay technology is being integrated with social media platforms like TikTok, allowing users to complete purchases directly within their apps. This shift represents the convergence of e-commerce and social media, potentially changing how consumers transact online.
content: Tap-to-pay is getting a TikTok makeover as shoppers turn checking out into a personalized accessory.

zh.title: 让开，信用卡：社交媒体明星正在挥动魔法棒购物
zh.summary: 点击支付技术正在与TikTok等社交媒体平台整合，允许用户在应用内直接完成购物。这一转变代表了电子商务和社交媒体的融合，可能改变消费者的在线交易方式。

title: Meta is the latest tech giant to land in her courtroom. Meet Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers
summary: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers is presiding over a landmark case involving Meta, adding to her track record of overseeing major tech industry trials. Her rulings in these high-profile cases carry significant implications for how large technology companies operate.
content: Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers has presided over a series of landmark tech trials and is now overseeing a case that could have a huge impact on Meta's future.

zh.title: Meta是最新登上她法庭的科技巨头。认识法官伊冯娜·冈萨雷斯·罗杰斯
zh.summary: 伊冯娜·冈萨雷斯·罗杰斯法官主持了一场涉及Meta的里程碑案件，这增加了她监督重大科技行业诉讼的记录。她在这些高调案件中的裁决对大型科技公司的运营方式具有重大意义。

title: Warren Buffett Watch: It's Buffett, not Abel, who appears to be calling the shots on stocks
summary: Warren Buffett appears to remain the primary decision-maker on Berkshire Hathaway's stock investments despite Greg Abel's appointment as CEO, working alongside portfolio manager Ted Weschler. This suggests continuity in the company's investment strategy despite the leadership transition.
content: New Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel appears to be letting Warren Buffett and portfolio manager Ted Weschler make all the decisions on the company's equities.

zh.title: 沃伦·巴菲特观察：看起来是巴菲特而不是阿贝尔在掌控股票决策
zh.summary: 尽管格雷格·阿贝尔被任命为首席执行官，但沃伦·巴菲特似乎仍是伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司股票投资的主要决策者，与投资组合经理泰德·韦施勒合作。这表明尽管领导层发生了变化，但公司的投资战略保持了连贯性。

title: Inside Coca-Cola’s secretive innovation labs: How the beverage giant wants to automate dirty soda and refreshers
summary: Coca-Cola is developing automation technology in its innovation labs to streamline production of specialized beverages including fountain drinks and refreshers. The initiative reflects the company's effort to increase operational efficiency and meet evolving consumer demands.
content: From McDonald's to Wendy's, longtime Coke customers have been expanding their beverage offerings to boost their profit margins.

zh.title: 可口可乐秘密创新实验室内部：这家饮料巨头如何自动化生产碳酸饮料和清爽饮品
zh.summary: 可口可乐正在其创新实验室中开发自动化技术，以简化包括喷泉饮料和清爽饮品在内的专业饮料的生产。该举措反映了公司提高运营效率和满足不断变化的消费者需求的努力。

title: For young Americans, the workplace is the new phoneless frontier. 'It allows us to hyper focus on the task at hand,' says employer
summary: Schools and employers are increasingly restricting phone use among teenagers, with employers citing improved focus and productivity as benefits. The trend reflects growing evidence of the significant impact phone use has on workplace performance and concentration.
content: Schools and increasingly teen employers are drawing a hard line against phone use. The benefits for teens can be profound.

zh.title: 对年轻美国人来说，工作场所成为新的"无手机区域"。"这让我们能够超级专注于手头的任务，"雇主表示
zh.summary: 学校和雇主越来越多地限制青少年的手机使用，雇主表示这提高了专注力和生产力。这一趋势反映了日益增多的证据表明手机使用对工作场所表现和集中力的重大影响。

title: ‘We are committed Christians’: Our son and daughter-in-law cut us out of their lives after a political argument. Should we change our $3 million will?
summary: Parents face a difficult decision about modifying their $3 million estate plan after their adult children ended contact following a political disagreement. The situation illustrates tensions between family reconciliation and wealth transfer decisions.
content: “We are hurt and confused, but we have also tried to respect the boundaries they have established.”

zh.title: "我们是承诺的基督徒"：我们的儿子和媳妇在政治争执后与我们断绝了关系。我们应该改变我们的300万美元遗产吗？
zh.summary: 父母在成年子女因政治分歧而断绝联系后，面临着是否修改其300万美元遗产计划的艰难决定。这种情况说明了家庭和解与财富转移决定之间的紧张关系。

title: Here’s some surprisingly good news for the stock market this midterm election year
summary: Historical market patterns suggest the stock market typically experiences strength in the period following midterm elections. This trend could provide optimism for investors navigating what is traditionally a volatile election year.
content: There is a strong historical pattern of postmidterm strength.

zh.title: 中期选举年股市迎来意外好消息
zh.summary: 历史市场模式表明，股市通常在中期选举之后的时期表现强劲。这一趋势可能为投资者带来乐观情绪，他们需要应对选举年传统上的波动性。

title: Ukrainian drones kill several, hit warehouse of Russian online retailer Ozon
summary: Ukrainian drones have struck a warehouse belonging to Ozon, Russia's second-largest online retailer, marking the first direct attack on the company. The attack is part of Ukraine's broader campaign to disrupt Russian economic infrastructure.
content: The strike is the first on Ozon, Russia's second-largest online retailer, which Ukraine sees as part of a wider campaign against economic infrastructure.

zh.title: 乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯在线零售商Ozon仓库，造成多人伤亡
zh.summary: 乌克兰无人机攻击了俄罗斯第二大在线零售商Ozon的仓库，这是对该公司的首次直接攻击。此次攻击是乌克兰破坏俄罗斯经济基础设施更广泛行动的一部分。

title: A massive ‘corporate welfare’ program is underway — and consumers want a bigger cut of it
summary: Tariff refunds stemming from President Trump's rejected tariffs are flowing back to companies, while consumers question why they are not receiving a share of the benefits. The issue raises questions about wealth distribution and the definition of corporate subsidies.
content: Tariff refunds have been flowing back to companies since President Donald Trump’s levies were rejected by the Supreme Court.

zh.title: 大规模"企业福利"计划进行中——消费者要求获得更大份额
zh.summary: 因特朗普总统被否决的关税而产生的关税退款正流向企业，消费者却质疑为何他们没有获得这些福利的份额。这个问题引发了关于财富分配和企业补贴定义的疑问。

title: Taxi drivers urge council to agree 8% fare hike
summary: Taxi drivers are seeking an 8% fare increase to help offset rising fuel prices and mounting living expenses. The proposal reflects the broader economic pressures affecting workers in the transportation sector.
content: Taxi fares could rise by 8% to help drivers combat rising fuel prices and the cost of living.

zh.title: 出租车司机敦促议会同意提高8%的车费
zh.summary: 出租车司机正在寻求提高8%的车费，以帮助抵消上升的燃料价格和不断增加的生活开支。这个提议反映了影响运输行业工人的更广泛的经济压力。

title: Ahead of tough new U.S. sanctions, Iran criticizes 'extraterritorial sovereignty'
summary: The U.S. is preparing new economic sanctions against Iran, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggesting these measures could reduce the need for military intervention. Iran has responded by criticizing what it views as overreach in U.S. exercise of foreign policy authority.
content: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Thursday that the proposed economic measures will likely negate the need for major U.S. military operations.

zh.title: 在美国新的严厉制裁前夕，伊朗批评"域外主权"
zh.summary: 美国正在准备对伊朗实施新的经济制裁，财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示这些措施可能会减少对军事干预的需要。伊朗对此做出回应，批评美国在行使外交政策权力时的越权行为。

title: ‘She’s desperate’: My friend was laid off and lost her health insurance. How can she find affordable coverage?
summary: An unemployed individual faces challenges finding affordable health insurance after losing employer-sponsored coverage, with COBRA proving too expensive. The situation highlights gaps in the U.S. health insurance system for workers transitioning between jobs.
content: “She looked into COBRA, but the cost is absolutely ridiculous.”

zh.title: "她很绝望"：我的朋友被裁员并失去了健康保险。她如何才能找到负担得起的保障？
zh.summary: 一个失业人士在失去雇主赞助的保险后，面临寻找负担得起的健康保险的困难，COBRA证明太昂贵。这种情况突显了美国健康保险系统对于在工作转变期间的工人的漏洞。

title: This has been one of the most affordable U.S. cities to buy a home for the past 134 years
summary: A Midwestern city has maintained home price affordability for over 134 years even as housing costs have risen dramatically elsewhere in the United States. The region's stability offers insights into long-term housing market dynamics and geographic variation in real estate affordability.
content: Home prices in America have changed dramatically over the last century — but the Midwest has remained a bastion of affordability through it all.

zh.title: 过去134年来，这一直是美国最经济实惠的购房城市之一
zh.summary: 美国中西部的一个城市在过去134年多来保持了房价的经济实惠性，尽管美国其他地区的房屋成本急剧上升。该地区的稳定性为长期住房市场动态和房地产可负担性的地理差异提供了见解。

title: Not 'poor enough': Do people use London's pay-it-forward schemes?
summary: London's pay-it-forward assistance programs designed to support residents struggling with cost-of-living expenses face questions about their actual uptake and accessibility. The programs' effectiveness may be constrained by eligibility barriers or limited public awareness.
content: The schemes are in place to help people who are struggling with the cost of living.

zh.title: "不够贫穷"：伦敦的互助援助计划有人使用吗？
zh.summary: 伦敦的互助援助计划原本旨在支持受生活成本困扰的居民，但其实际使用率和可及性面临质疑。这些计划的有效性可能受到资格限制或公众认识不足的制约。

title: U.S., Canada fail to reach a tariff deal, deepen trade war
summary: The U.S. and Canada failed to reach a trade agreement on Friday, with the U.S. announcing 50% tariffs on certain Canadian imports. This escalation deepens trade tensions between the two neighboring nations and could significantly impact bilateral commerce.
content: The United States and Canada failed to reach a trade deal late on Friday, and the U.S. said it would impose 50% tariffs on some imports from Canada.

zh.title: 美国和加拿大未能达成关税协议，加剧贸易战
zh.summary: 美国和加拿大周五未能达成贸易协议，美国宣布对某些加拿大进口商品征收50%关税。这一升级加剧了两个邻国之间的贸易紧张局势，可能会对双边贸易产生重大影响。

title: Six investors reveal the biggest market risks — and one strategy they agree on
summary: Major investors have identified various threats to market stability but largely converge on the recommendation to diversify holdings beyond recent market winners. This consensus suggests caution about concentrated positions in currently trending assets.
content: Investors see different risks threatening markets, but broadly agree that traders should diversify beyond recent winners.

zh.title: 六位投资者揭示最大的市场风险——以及他们一致同意的一项策略
zh.summary: 主要投资者已识别出各种市场稳定性威胁，但在建议将持仓多样化、超越近期市场赢家的建议上基本达成共识。这种共识表明对当前趋势资产集中头寸需要谨慎。

title: 'We have more work to do', says Canada negotiator as US trade deadline looms
summary: US-Canada trade negotiations are approaching a Friday deadline, with Canadian negotiators signaling significant work remains to finalize a deal.
content: Negotiations to finalise a deal between the US and Canada are going down to the wire ahead of a Friday night deadline.

zh.title: "我们还有很多工作要做"，加拿大谈判代表在美国贸易截止日期临近时说道
zh.summary: 美加贸易谈判正在接近周五的截止日期，加拿大谈判代表表示完成协议仍需大量工作。

title: Pentagon fires U.S. military newspaper leadership
summary: The editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes military newspaper was fired for insubordination, raising questions about editorial independence in military media.
content: The editor-in-chief of the Stars and Stripes U.S. military newspaper said on Friday that he was being fired for insubordination.

zh.title: 五角大楼解雇美国军事报纸领导层
zh.summary: 《星条旗》军事报纸主编因违抗命令被解雇，引发了对军事媒体编辑独立性的质疑。
